headline: EPL Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - EPL Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Observation Letters from BSE and NSE in relation to Scheme of Amalgamation of Indovida India Private Limited with the Company and their respective shareholders
